organoleptic.color: Uniform golden-brown color with evenly baked pastry layers.
organoleptic.taste: Characteristic savory pastry taste with a well-balanced filling flavor.
organoleptic.texture: Crispy, flaky outer layers with a soft and moist filling.
organoleptic.defects: None acceptable (no foreign matter, off-odor, discoloration, or coating separation)

functional.freezeThaw: Stable under frozen storage; no structural damage after thawing.
functional.textureAfterThaw: Juicy and soft interior; crispy coating after cooking.
functional.structuralIntegrity: Maintains shape; coating adheres well to the core.
functional.cuttingStability: Clean cut; no crumbling or separation.
functional.bakeStability: Shape and coating remain stable during baking.

organoleptic.appearance: Golden-brown, evenly baked surface with visible fine shredded pastry layers; cheese filling uniformly distributed.
organoleptic.color: Golden to light amber on the exterior; creamy white cheese interior.
organoleptic.taste: Sweet and buttery with balanced syrup sweetness; rich dairy flavor from melted cheese.
organoleptic.texture: Crispy exterior with soft, elastic, and fully melted cheese interior; not soggy or overly dry.
organoleptic.defects: Burnt or pale surface, uneven baking, excessive syrupiness or dryness, hardened or unmelted cheese.
